title: DRMOT: A Dataset and Framework for RGBD Referring Multi-Object Tracking
abstract: arXiv:2602.04692v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Referring Multi-Object Tracking (RMOT) aims to track specific targets based on language descriptions, playing a vital role in interactive AI systems such as robotics and autonomous driving. However, existing RMOT methods rely exclusively on 2D RGB observations. Since similar 2D projections can correspond to different 3D configurations, the available observations may not uniquely determine the referred targets. This creates a fundamental mismatch between the task requirements and the available input. To advance research on the DRMOT task, we construct DRSet, a dataset tailored for the DRMOT task. DRSet comprises 2,076 referring expressions over 186 RGB-D source sequences. It features synchronized RGB images and depth maps paired with language descriptions, including explicit depth-dependent descriptions, to systematically evaluate spatial-semantic detection and tracking capabilities. translated_title: DRMOT：一个面向RGBD指代多目标跟踪的数据集与框架
translated_abstract: 指代多目标跟踪（RMOT）旨在根据语言描述跟踪特定目标，在机器人和自动驾驶等交互式人工智能系统中发挥着重要作用。然而，现有的RMOT方法完全依赖于2D RGB观测。由于相似的2D投影可能对应不同的3D配置，可用的观测可能无法唯一确定被指代的目标，这在任务需求与可用输入之间造成了根本性的不匹配。为了推进DRMOT任务的研究，我们构建了DRSet，一个专门为DRMOT任务定制的数据集。DRSet包含186个RGB-D源序列上的2,076条指代表达。该数据集具有与语言描述配对的同步RGB图像和深度图，其中包含显式的深度相关描述，以系统地评估空间语义检测与跟踪能力。此外，我们提出了DRTrack，一个由多模态大语言模型（MLLM）引导的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了首个面向RGBD指代多目标跟踪（DRMOT）任务的数据集DRSet和由多模态大语言模型引导的跟踪框架DRTrack，通过引入深度信息解决了仅靠2D观测无法唯一确定指代目标的根本性问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DRSet, the first dataset tailored for RGBD Referring Multi-Object Tracking (DRMOT), and DRTrack, an MLLM-guided tracking framework, which leverages depth information to resolve the fundamental mismatch where 2D RGB observations alone cannot uniquely determine referred targets.
